findings.highlight: You skipped practice the whole day yesterday
findings.evidenceJa: 一昨日、稽古抜け出した時
findings.explanation: Uehara says Chiaki slipped out of rehearsal the day before yesterday to see Haruki. The translation moves it to yesterday and expands the absence into the whole day.
findings.japanese:
「結局、彼氏と仲直りできなかったのか？
一昨日、稽古抜け出した時会いに行ったんだろ」
findings.todokanai: "So you didn't make up with your boyfriend in the end, huh? You skipped practice the whole day yesterday just so you could meet him, right?"

findings.highlight: the first day of spring
findings.evidenceJa: 春一番にはほど遠かった
findings.explanation: 春一番 is the season's first strong southerly wind, not the calendar's first day of spring. The piercing wind is far from that herald of spring even though March begins tomorrow.
findings.japanese:
明日から三月だってのに、
肌を突き刺す風は、春一番にはほど遠かった。
findings.todokanai: Although it's going to be March by tomorrow, the way the wind pierces my skin suggests that there's still quite a long time before the first day of spring will arrive.

findings.highlight: there's more than a small trickle of people coming and going no matter the time
findings.evidenceJa: どの時間帯でも人の往来が寂しいことになっていた
findings.explanation: The station has sparse, lonely foot traffic at every time of day. The translation says there is more than a small trickle at all times, reversing the description of the nearly deserted district.
findings.japanese:
もともとあまり栄えていない、
大学から二番目に近いこの駅は、
どの時間帯でも人の往来が寂しいことになっていた。
findings.todokanai: This station is the second nearest to my university, and it was never really a prosperous area to begin with. It feels as if there's more than a small trickle of people coming and going no matter the time.

findings.highlight: please consider letting me join
findings.evidenceJa: 参加は考えさせてください
findings.explanation: Tanaka asks to be allowed to think about whether she would participate in a future professional troupe. The translation asks Uehara to consider allowing her to join, reversing who is making the decision.
findings.japanese: 「えっと、参加は考えさせてください」
findings.todokanai: "Um, please consider letting me join."

findings.highlight: you just look a little giddy
findings.evidenceJa: ふらついてるように見える
findings.explanation: Yoshida says Chiaki looks physically unsteady or as though she is staggering, an early sign of her collapse. 'Giddy' substitutes an emotional state and weakens the medical foreshadowing.
findings.japanese: 「いや、ふらついてるように見えるんで」
findings.todokanai: "Nothing, you just look a little giddy."

findings.highlight: "Please don't joke around like that. I know I'm not fully prepared, but I'm not as nervous as you think I am, either."
findings.evidenceJa:
「冗談やめてください。
そこまで緊張するほど準備不足じゃないです」
findings.explanation: Yoshida says he is not so underprepared that he would be that nervous; the English unnecessarily admits that he is not fully prepared.
findings.japanese:
「冗談やめてください。
そこまで緊張するほど準備不足じゃないです」
findings.todokanai: "Please don't joke around like that. I know I'm not fully prepared, but I'm not as nervous as you think I am, either."

findings.highlight: she's had to change her pastimes and personality so as to not reveal her hobby
findings.evidenceJa: 興じると人格が変わってしまうその趣味を他人に晒すことができずに
findings.explanation: Yukine cannot reveal karaoke because indulging in it transforms her personality, conflicting with the aloof beauty she must perform. The translation says she changed her pastimes and personality, losing the comic split between public persona and hidden hobby.
findings.japanese:
けれど高嶺の花を演じなくてはならない今は、
興じると人格が変わってしまうその趣味を
他人に晒すことができずに、悶々とした日々を送る。
findings.todokanai: Nevertheless, she spends her days in discontent. Placed on such a high pedestal in school, she's had to change her pastimes and personality so as to not reveal her hobby to anyone.

findings.highlight: only has her cuteness going for her
findings.evidenceJa: 歌が上手くて可愛いだけの素人ボーカリスト
findings.explanation: The amateur vocalist has two assets: she sings well and is cute. The translation says cuteness is the only thing she has going for her, erasing the singing ability on which her role in the band depends.
findings.japanese:
歌が上手くて可愛いだけの素人ボーカリストと、
博識だけど技術は凡庸で融通の利かないギタリストは、
練習風景一つ取っても、何かと会話が噛み合わない。
findings.todokanai: The amateur singer who's good at singing but only has her cuteness going for her, and the stubborn guitarist who's knowledgeable but very mediocre. They didn't seem to be on the same wavelength during practice.

findings.highlight: she boasts a dominant presence in the school
findings.evidenceJa: 学園ナンバー１空気。但し不穏な
findings.explanation: Haruna is the school's number-one 'air'—an invisible nonentity, albeit an ominous one. The translation calls her a dominant presence, stating the opposite of the social joke.
findings.japanese:
雪音に負けず劣らずの美貌と、
雪音とは勝負にならない圧倒的不人気を誇る、
学園ナンバー１空気。但し不穏な。
findings.todokanai: With an infamous streak that's a stark contrast to Yukine's popularity despite their rivaling looks, she boasts a dominant presence in the school. Though an unsettling one, at that.

findings.highlight: I've never finished below second place
findings.evidenceJa: 二位に落ちたことすらない
findings.explanation: Haruna says she has never even fallen to second place: she always wins. 'Never below second' allows second-place finishes and materially understates the prodigy's record.
findings.japanese:
「…なんでこのあたしがお前なんかに巻き込まれて
コンテストで笑い者にならなくちゃいけないんだ。
自分のコンクールじゃ二位に落ちたことすらないのに」
findings.todokanai: "…Why did I of all people get involved with you, anyway? It's pretty obvious that this band is going to be nothing more than the laughingstock of the contest. And to think I've never finished below second place in any of my own competitions."

findings.highlight: how innocent the two actors are on stage
findings.evidenceJa: 彼らが演じる二人があまりにも初々しくて
findings.explanation: Haruki is embarrassed by how innocent the two characters portrayed by the actors are. The translation attributes that innocence to the actors themselves, collapsing the play's actor-character distinction.
findings.japanese:
彼らが演じる二人があまりにも初々しくて、
何故か俺の顔から火が出そうだったから。
findings.todokanai: For some reason, I'm feeling incredibly embarrassed about how innocent the two actors are on stage.

findings.highlight: there will be a day where it can be reflected upon your heart
findings.evidenceJa: 届かない恋をしていても、映しだす日がくるかな
findings.explanation: The lyric wonders whether a day will come when this unreachable love can be reflected or made visible. The translation invents 'upon your heart,' supplies a declarative future instead of the question's uncertainty, and leaves the load-bearing title untranslated in the preceding phrase.
findings.japanese:
「『届かない恋をしていても、映しだす日がくるかな』…
すごい、すごいよ和希くん…意外な才能～」
findings.todokanai: "'Even if these feelings can never be conveyed, there will be a day where it can be reflected upon your heart'… Amazing… this is amazing, Kazuki-kun… You have an unexpected talent～"

findings.highlight: I'm going to give you a dose of reality
findings.evidenceJa: わたし今思いっきり落胆してるから
findings.explanation: Yukine says she herself is bitterly disappointed because Kazuki mistook her expectation of a kiss for a lucky charm. The translation instead has her announce that she will give him a dose of reality.
findings.japanese:
「あ、俺今いい話でまとめたな～って
なんか自己満足に浸ってるみたいだけど、
外してるから。わたし今思いっきり落胆してるから！」
findings.todokanai: "Ah, you have this smug look on your face that says 'I just said something cool,' but I'll have you know you're off by a long shot! I'm going to give you a dose of reality!"

findings.highlight: I'm doing this because it's you, Yukine
findings.evidenceJa: 雪音に限って、そんな
findings.explanation: Kazuki protests that surely Yukine of all people could not have expected something sexual or romantic, which is why she accuses him of treating her as an ornament. The translation says he acted especially because it was her, turning his desexualizing assumption into romantic preference.
findings.japanese:
「い、いや、まさか…
雪音に限って、そんな…」
findings.todokanai: "N-No, that can't be… Well, I'm doing this because it's you, Yukine…"

findings.highlight: my right hand that's leaning against the cold wall
findings.evidenceJa: 冷たい床に置かれていた俺の右手
findings.explanation: Haruki's right hand is resting on the cold floor when Setsuna places hers over it. The translation relocates the hand to the wall, making the subsequent physical arrangement difficult to reconstruct.
findings.japanese:
冷たい床に置かれていた俺の右手に、
温かさが重なる。
findings.todokanai: I feel warmth enveloping my right hand that's leaning against the cold wall.

findings.highlight: Is this gonna mess up the whole thing
findings.evidenceJa: 失格になるんじゃないのかなぁ
findings.explanation: The planted spectator wonders whether the band will be disqualified. The translation turns a concrete contest consequence into the vague possibility of messing up the whole thing.
findings.japanese:
「失格になるんじゃないのかなぁ…
なんか勿体ないよな、決して悪くないのに」
findings.todokanai: "Is this gonna mess up the whole thing…? It'd be such a waste. I thought it was going pretty well, too!"

findings.highlight: They became the audience of the competition in the play
findings.evidenceJa: 彼らは、芝居の観客ではなく、コンテストの観衆役
findings.explanation: The nearby troupe members are not ordinary theatergoers becoming absorbed; they are playing the roles of spectators at the fictional competition. The translation conceals that the apparent audience chatter is deliberately staged.
findings.japanese:
彼らは、芝居の観客ではなく、コンテストの観衆役…
こんなところにまで『芝居』が仕込んである。
findings.todokanai: They are no longer the audience here to watch the stage play. They became the audience of the competition in the play… That's how deeply the performance has drawn in its audience.

findings.highlight: they've completely fallen for the illusion
findings.evidenceJa: 彼らが舞台の三人の演奏に聴き入ることで、俺たちまでもが
findings.explanation: By visibly listening to the trio, the planted competition spectators induce the real audience—including Haruki and Setsuna—to experience the scene as a live concert. The translation makes the planted performers themselves victims of the illusion, reversing how the theatrical device works.
findings.japanese:
彼らが舞台の三人の演奏に聴き入ることで、
俺たちまでもが、これが芝居ではなく
ライブだという錯覚を植えつけられていく。
findings.todokanai: While listening to the three performing on stage, they've completely fallen for the illusion that they're watching the competition liveーand so have we.

findings.highlight: if you know it for a fact now, you'll get another chance to make one
findings.evidenceJa: 既成事実ならまた作れば
findings.explanation: 既成事実 is a fait accompli: Uehara awkwardly suggests that if Chiaki wanted pregnancy or sex as an irreversible fact tying Haruki to her, she could make another one. The translation mistakes the idiom for knowing something as fact and becomes incoherent.
findings.japanese:
「残念だったけど…
まぁその、既成事実ならまた作れば」
findings.todokanai: "It's unfortunate, but… if you know it for a fact now, you'll get another chance to make one."

findings.highlight: Yukine will definitely push the story toward a dark ending
findings.evidenceJa: 雪音は、物語の闇に突き落とされていくだろう
findings.explanation: Haruki predicts that the merciless script will cast Yukine down into the story's darkness. The translation makes Yukine the agent who pushes the story toward darkness.
findings.japanese:
きっとあいつは、この先容赦なんかしない。
雪音は、物語の闇に突き落とされていくだろう。
findings.todokanai: She definitely won't show any mercy to me. Yukine will definitely push the story toward a dark ending.

findings.highlight: the two of us will end up having our hearts gouged out
findings.evidenceJa: 抉られた俺が言うんだから間違いない
findings.explanation: Haruki says there can be no mistake because he speaks as someone Chiaki has already gouged emotionally. The translation invents a prediction about both Haruki and Setsuna being wounded instead of grounding the claim in his past experience.
findings.japanese: 何しろ、抉られた俺が言うんだから間違いない。
findings.todokanai: In any case, there's no doubt that the two of us will end up having our hearts gouged out, at least.

findings.highlight: she had to hide her feelings for Kazuki inside her heart
findings.evidenceJa: 和希への募る想いとは裏腹に、二人の時間をじわじわと奪われていく
findings.explanation: As Yukine rises to stardom, time with Kazuki is gradually taken from her despite her growing love for him. The translation invents concealment of her feelings and loses the distance produced by her career.
findings.japanese:
スター街道を駆け上がっていく雪音は、
和希への募る想いとは裏腹に、
二人の時間をじわじわと奪われていく。
findings.todokanai: Since Yukine was a popular star, she had to hide her feelings for Kazuki inside her heart, so the time they spent together drastically decreased.

findings.highlight: the poison that was spreading throughout his entire body
findings.evidenceJa: その毒が全身に回っていくのを抑えられなくなる
findings.explanation: By drawing Kazuki's pain out of him, Haruna finds that its poison spreads through her own body and can no longer suppress it. The translation assigns the poison to Kazuki, eliminating the image of his confidante absorbing his suffering.
findings.japanese:
二人の共通の友人というスタンスを守り続ける榛名は、
和希の悩みや辛さを吸い出してあげているうちに、
その毒が全身に回っていくのを抑えられなくなる。
findings.todokanai: As the friend who watched over them, Haruna tried to help Kazuki vent out his problems. But she couldn't suppress the poison that was spreading throughout his entire body.

findings.highlight: may not have thought of it as a mistake, but it was indeed the gravest mistake of all
findings.evidenceJa: 榛名と和希にとって、それが過ちではなかったことが、最大の過ちだった
findings.explanation: The paradox is that for Haruna and Kazuki their union genuinely was not a mistake—and that very fact was the greatest mistake. The translation reduces this to their possibly failing to recognize an objectively grave mistake.
findings.japanese:
…榛名と和希にとって、それが過ちではなかったことが、
最大の過ちだった。
findings.todokanai: …Haruna and Kazuki may not have thought of it as a mistake, but it was indeed the gravest mistake of all.

findings.highlight: Haruna, who abandoned her piano, stayed by Kazuki's side
findings.evidenceJa: ピアノを捨てた榛名には、和希が側に残り
findings.explanation: Kazuki remains beside Haruna, who abandoned the piano, while Yukine is left only with song. The translation makes Haruna the one who stays beside Kazuki, reversing the result of their sacrifices.
findings.japanese:
ピアノを捨てた榛名には、和希が側に残り、
捨てなかった雪音には、歌だけが残される。
findings.todokanai: Haruna, who abandoned her piano, stayed by Kazuki's side; Yukine, who did not cast aside her singing, only had her singing with her.

findings.highlight: If I keep chasing my love with everything I have, I'll grasp it one day
findings.evidenceJa: 自分の恋を追いかけて、一生懸命やってたら、いつの間にかチャンスを掴んでいた
findings.explanation: Yukine says that while pursuing her love and working with all her might, she found she had already seized a career opportunity before she knew it. The translation changes that accomplished history into a future promise to grasp love someday.
findings.japanese:
「自分の恋を追いかけて、一生懸命やってたら、
いつの間にかチャンスを掴んでいたけれど」
findings.todokanai: "If I keep chasing my love with everything I have, I'll grasp it one day."

findings.highlight: Her love has definitely gone too far and is one that she's forced upon him
findings.evidenceJa: 彼女の愛情は、決して行き過ぎず、押しつけず、けれど控えもせず
findings.explanation: The narration says Yukine's love never goes too far and is never imposed, yet is not held back either. The translation states exactly the opposite: that it definitely goes too far and is forced upon Kazuki.
findings.japanese:
彼女の愛情は、決して行き過ぎず、押しつけず、
けれど控えもせず、強く、優しく…
findings.todokanai: Her love has definitely gone too far and is one that she's forced upon him, but it's also boundless, strong, and kind…

findings.highlight: "Abandoning something in order to obtain something else is something I don't like doing."
findings.evidenceJa:
「何か一つを捨てて、他の全てを手に入れるなんて、
そんなバランス感覚、わたしにはないもの」
findings.explanation: Yukine rejects sacrificing one thing to obtain all the rest; the English reduces this to abandoning one thing to obtain another.
findings.japanese:
「何か一つを捨てて、他の全てを手に入れるなんて、
そんなバランス感覚、わたしにはないもの」
findings.todokanai: "Abandoning something in order to obtain something else is something I don't like doing."

findings.highlight: I won't ask you to believe me
findings.evidenceJa: 信じてる、なんて言わない
findings.explanation: Yukine says she will not claim that she trusts Kazuki regardless of whom he chooses. The translation instead says she will not ask Kazuki to believe her, reversing the direction of trust.
findings.japanese:
「信じてる、なんて言わない。
和希くんがわたしと榛名のどっちを選んでも、
それが間違ってるなんて思わない」
findings.todokanai: "I won't ask you to believe me. I don't think it would be wrong for you to choose either me or Haruna, Kazuki-kun."

findings.highlight: locked in a mutual battle of love and hate
findings.evidenceJa: 最後の最後までお互いを愛し合い、そして潰し合った
findings.explanation: Yukine and Haruna continue loving one another even as they destroy one another. The translation replaces this simultaneous mutual love and mutual destruction with a conventional battle of love and hate.
findings.japanese:
雪音も榛名も、
最後の最後までお互いを愛し合い、
そして潰し合った。
findings.todokanai: Yukine and Haruna were locked in a mutual battle of love and hate until the very end.

findings.highlight: we're almost done packing up
findings.evidenceJa: 公演の方もだいぶ押しましたし
findings.explanation: Yoshida explains that it is 1 a.m. because the performance itself ran substantially late. The translation instead says they are almost finished packing up, changing the reason for the time.
findings.japanese:
「ええと…夜中の一時ですね。
ま、公演の方もだいぶ押しましたし」
findings.todokanai: "Let's see… It's 1 AM. Well, we're almost done packing up."

findings.highlight: I'm going to be abandoned without getting a say in it
findings.evidenceJa: 問答無用に捨てられちゃったじゃないかよ
findings.explanation: Chiaki says she has consequently already been dumped without discussion. The translation moves the abandonment into the future even though her breakdown is a reaction to Haruki having rejected her.
findings.japanese:
「おかげであたし…
問答無用に捨てられちゃったじゃないかよ」
findings.todokanai: "But now, I… I'm going to be abandoned without getting a say in it, huh?"

findings.highlight: inflicting wounds upon myself that will never heal
findings.evidenceJa: 自分に癒せない傷が刻まれるから
findings.explanation: Haruki does not want to wound Setsuna because scars he himself cannot heal will be carved into her. The translation relocates those wounds onto Haruki, undermining the stated reason for ending the relationship.
findings.japanese:
「俺はもう、雪菜を傷つけたくない。
だって、自分に癒せない傷が刻まれるから」
findings.todokanai: "I don't want to hurt you anymore, Setsuna. Because I know I'll only keep inflicting wounds upon myself that will never heal if this goes on."

findings.highlight: It's been snowing all along
findings.evidenceJa: 雪が、降っていた
findings.explanation: The narration simply reveals that snow was falling in Chiaki's later-night scene. Adding 'all along' invents continuous duration and conflicts with the parallel earlier scene, where Haruki says the snow has finally begun.
findings.japanese: 雪が、降っていた。
findings.todokanai: It's been snowing all along.
